text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho!
It's Sweep Tosho!
Sweep Tosho has done it!!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Haaah... hic, haaah...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's been a full 39 years!
It's been 39 years since a winner came
from the Triple Tiara route!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Holding off a field of top contenders!
Sweep Tosho, arriving at Takarazuka from the Triple Tiara path,
has seized first place!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Sweep Tosho was strong—so strong!
A stunned silence falls over the venue!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
You gotta be kidding, right? But she...
Seriously? How could that...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
...! Oh, clapping!
The race is already over!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap... clap clap, clap...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOO!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――A burst of cheers and roaring applause,
delayed by far more than just a single beat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "And yet, I felt as though that very fact symbolized the sheer greatness of what Sweep Tosho had accomplished..."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Aha... jeez.
Ugh, you're so loud...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Ms. Sweep.
That was truly splendid.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Rob Roy.
What's that? Such simple words for a bookworm.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Couldn't you praise me a little more? ...I mean, I did just fight the greatest hero and win, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san...
Fufu, yes, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I am sorry.
Though I have read hundreds, thousands of books,
right now, I can offer you no higher praise than this.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Because... dammit, because I'm so frustrated!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It hurts... It hurts so much, I can hardly bear it.
I didn't want to yield this race!
I wanted to win it so badly...!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: In the name of a hero! I wanted to plunge my blade right into the heart of the witch I admired!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
—I'm sorry, I'm going to go cool my head.
Thank you for your hard work today...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Aha, what's this?
Look at you, saying something so cool.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Still, Rob Roy, having you with me made it
the most fun I've ever had.
And because you were there, I—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —I was able to use the magic of the ultimate race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The change started drop by drop at first.
Like tiny droplets creating ripples upon the water.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
“—And that's what made me think of it.
After watching Sweep Tosho's run that day.”

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: I bet Umamusume from the Triple Tiara will go on to win all sorts of GⅠ races, Senior year or whenever!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With each passing day, those ripples
spread out little by little, growing larger and larger—"

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: “For the Tenno Sho (Autumn), I'm planning to go watch the girl I've been cheering on through the Triple Tiara path!”

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Or more accurately, her *winning*.
...I mean, it's not totally impossible, right?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
"That's totally what I think!
After being shown a Takarazuka Kinen like that!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That swell eventually—engulfed the entire world.

text_block_list.name: Passerby C
text_block_list.text:
"W-Well, what if! Just what if, okay?!
What if a girl coming off the Triple Tiara route like that—"

text_block_list.name: Passerby C
text_block_list.text: Matching—no, even surpassing the "Seven Crowns" of President Symboli Rudolf! Could it be that you might set a new record for GⅠ victories?!

text_block_list.name: Passerby C
text_block_list.text:
"I can't really say for sure that it isn't
anymore. It's like... my whole concept
of common sense got completely blown away."

text_block_list.name: Passerby C
text_block_list.text: You're right, it's almost like—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As if under a magic spell,
they recounted."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“Whether Triple Crown or Triple Tiara,
the truly strong Umamusume is the one who reigns supreme. That is what Sweep Tosho proved with her run—”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "It was undeniably a turning point in history."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Having finished reading the article, she then flashed a grin.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —Or so they say, familiar.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "Magic," you say!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Confident and energetic—
and more innocent than ever before.
